Owner decision, 21 September 2026 (Claude Code session): DEFER the CI route. Neither billing remediation nor a runner route is chosen now. Until a route exists, local exact-SHA gates (checkAll with bound test totals, under SD2) qualify engineering; they do not count as an executed CI pass, and the G5 stable-delivery gate stays open. Recorded in docs/refactor/PLAN.md section 6 at 473c6959.

Evidence gathered for the decision: the repository is already public (gh api repos/bbuchsbaum/storymodel4s: visibility=public), so GitHub-hosted minutes would be free. Run 35406786299 (2026-09-18, SHA 1113f968) never started: both job annotations read "The job was not started because recent account payments have failed or your spending limit needs to be increased." This is an account-level billing block, not a Scala failure. Options presented: fix billing; self-hosted runner (Linux needed to match the ubuntu/Temurin matrix; GitHub advises against self-hosted runners on public repos); defer. No visibility or spending change is inferred.

Acceptance 1 is therefore NOT met (no route chosen); this ticket stays open and its CI dependents (bd-01M19G69RQCHMT2EMG11XFT4WX, bd-01M2TAKTB61XNXV4Y6A9J3CB0C) stay blocked. Push status: owner asked for main to be pushed at the end of this session's pass; origin/main is still 1113f968 at the time of this note, local main 138 ahead.
